sourceReferences.supports: Many neuter first-declension nouns form singular genitive in -а or -я, according to the hard/soft declension pattern. Neuter nouns ending in -мя form oblique cases from a stem expanded with н, e.g. время → времени. The cited paradigms attest болото → болота, поле → поля, and время → времени.
